title: Media Arts: Directing
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

not_verbatim: After successful completion of this program, students will be able to use their thorough background in the aesthetics of film and media to apply to productions.
After successful completion of this program, students will be able to experience directing actors from casting through the rehearsing process to better prepare them to work with actors on a set.
